newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa says upbeat for 1996/1997 year.
newsitem.headline: Degussa says upbeat for 1996/1997 year.

text.p: German chemicals and metals group Degussa AG said on Friday that it expected profit to rise in the 1996/1997 fiscal year to September 30.

"We continue to view the ongoing developments in the business year 1996/1997 as positive," Degussa management board chairman Uwe-Ernst Bufe told shareholders in a text prepared for delivery at the annual shareholders meeting.
Barring any unforeseen downturn in the global economic climate, Bufe said, "In the group we expect to post another improved result compared to the year before."
In 1995/1996, Degussa made a net profit of 302 million marks.
